NAM.note: Cabinet directed an internal civil-service AI policy to be co-developed; not issued, so no fact.

facts.fact: Commentator Hafeni Kashimbonde writes of Namibia 'in the absence of explicit, standalone national AI laws', where parastatals remain bound by corporate governance and privacy law.

NAM.note: Only an internal civil-service AI policy is directed, not a national AI strategy.

facts.fact: Commentator Hafeni Kashimbonde refers to 'Data Protection Bills in Namibia' as the country's national privacy protection, with no law in force named.
